**r01** — False premise. There is no Redis in this codebase. The cache is a pure in-memory Go implementation using `sync.Map` (`store/cache/cache.go`). Three caches are created in `store/store.go:51-53` (`instanceSettingCache`, `userCache`, `userSettingCache`) with a default TTL of 10 minutes (`store/cache/cache.go:72`).

**r02** — False premise. There is no per-user API rate-limiting middleware. The interceptor chain (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:133-138`) consists of `MetadataInterceptor`, `LoggingInterceptor`, `RecoveryInterceptor`, and `AuthInterceptor` only. No rate limiter exists.

**r03** — False premise. There is no nightly database-cleanup cron job. The `internal/scheduler` package exists as a library but is never imported or used by the server. No scheduled cleanup jobs are registered anywhere.

**r04** — False premise. Neither NATS nor RabbitMQ is used. Webhook delivery uses an in-process buffered Go channel (`asyncPostQueue = make(chan *WebhookRequestPayload, 128)` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`) drained by 4 goroutine workers started in `init()` (line 42). There is no message broker.

**r05** — False premise. There is no GraphQL schema. The API is defined using Protocol Buffers in `proto/api/v1/*.proto`, exposed via gRPC-Gateway (REST at `/api/v1/*`) and ConnectRPC (browser-compatible gRPC), registered at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:99-144`.
